import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static int[] getInput(Scanner scanner) {
        String[] parts = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        int[] result = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            result[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static long opow(long a, long b, long mod) {
        long ans = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * a) % mod;
            }
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1; // divide by 2
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] inputs = getInput(scanner);
        int p = inputs[0];
        int k = inputs[1];
        long mod = 1000000007;
        long ans = 0;

        if (k == 0) {
            ans = opow(p, p - 1, mod);
        } else {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
                if ((p - 1) % i == 0 && opow(k, i, p) == 1) {
                    ans = opow(p, (p - 1) / i, mod);
                    if (k == 1) {
                        ans = (ans * p) % mod;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
